title: PHP Armageddon: OpenAI, Google’s Wiz find ancient holes, panicking the internet
hook_text: OpenAI and Google find ancient PHP holes.
script:
OpenAI and Google cloud security researchers at Wiz uncovered massive security flaws hiding inside PHP since version five came out in two thousand and four.
These ancient bugs sat undetected for over two decades across legacy code bases.
Advanced AI tools successfully located the vulnerabilities by deeply scanning complex server architecture.
Millions of web applications running PHP are now exposed to severe risk.
Engineers must patch their systems immediately before automated attacks compromise production servers.
Can your development team secure legacy code before it breaks?
